[P3] 从前有个叫鲁迪的小男孩，
想要一只小狗，
他不停地要求；
不停地恳求；
不停地祈求。

献给贝蒂·鲍金斯·阿尔德里奇，你是我一生的挚友！
——多罗西娅·P. 西伯

献给罗伯特和珍妮塔，谢谢你们让我读到这个故事。
——杨志成

[P4] 妈妈说：
“鲁迪想要一只宠物，
我想给他一只小猫。
小猫聪明又伶俐，活泼又机灵，
我会给他一只小猫。”

鲁迪哭喊道：
“小猫一点儿都不好，
你想和它玩，它却跑开了，
我只想要一只小狗！”

[P5] 爸爸过来帮忙，说：
“我小时候养过一只乌龟，
小小的乌龟慢慢地爬，
我会给鲁迪一只乌龟。”

鲁迪哭喊着：
“乌龟根本不会跑，
不是一动不动，就是慢慢爬。
我只想要一只小狗！”

[P6] 马大姑要搬家到罗马，
“我的金丝雀需要一个新家。
我要送给亲爱的小鲁迪，
他比别人都适合拥有它。
我会把金丝雀送给他。”

鲁迪哭喊道：
“金丝雀不会取东西，
只会站在树上晃悠悠，
一天到晚叫叽叽。
我只想要一只小狗！”

[P7] 胖乎乎的该利说：
“金鱼很不错，
浑身亮闪闪、光灿灿，
我会送几条给鲁迪。”

鲁迪哭喊道：
“金鱼不能床上睡，
浑身湿乎乎、冰凉凉、滑溜溜。
我只想要一只小狗！”

[P8] 哈大叔有个天大的好消息，
迫不及待地打电话给鲁迪：
“喂，我爱兔子又生了好多小兔子，
鲁迪快来，带两只回去玩。”

鲁迪哭喊道：
“兔子不会捉老鼠，
宝宝生不停，鼻子扭不止，
一个下午懒洋洋。
我只想要一只小狗！”

[P9] 伤心的鲁迪跑出家，来到小路。
他一路跑过村庄，
经过大街拐角，向左来到大路，
跑进一个动物收容所，
那里走跑的动物多又多。

鲁迪喘着气说：
“我只想要一只小狗！
请给我一只小狗，我会训练它，喂养它。
我们会到森林里徒步，风雨无阻，
只要你给我一只小狗做宠物。”

[P10] 他们带鲁迪到一个房间，很多小狗装在盒子里。
有的小，有的大，有的像小狐狸。
每只小狗都让鲁迪着迷。
鲁迪仔细瞅瞅这些小狗。
突然，他看到了一只小狗，高兴地叫起来：
“我找到了！我找到了！”

[P11] 我只要这只小狗！
我只要这个小男孩！

[P12] 他从木箱里出来，不紧不慢，穿着蓝色牛仔裤。
杰特嗅了嗅，闻了闻。
杰特的尾巴像旗帜，只像高高的水滴。
它高兴地叫起来：‘我，我找到了！’

[P13] 鲁特高兴地躺下来，在一个大盒子里面睡觉。
里面铺着柔软的纸，鲁特好舒服了。
这时，所有的狗一起在汪叫。
“看这儿，鲁特！”一个男人说，
“看你四处流浪真辛苦，
黑得小小，腿脚麻木，
来我们家吧，
不用去流浪狗园。”

[P14] 小狗很不高兴。
跑得上气不接下气。
自己的气冲冲，
像一截子掉进树根中。
冲到十字大街。

李小姐住在城里，
养了二十二只大猫和一只小猫。
她看见杰森飞快地跑，马上大声叫：
“快来给我抱的猫咪做做保健！”，

[P15] 鲁迪站长是个孤独的人。
他坐在售票处，
只要听到列车的汽笛声和他打招呼。
夜晚，本特跳上了铁轨，
站长使劲吹哨子，想唤回本特，
可是——
本特追跑了。
它能找到一个小小男孩，
能给它一条床，本特紧了能躺一躺。

[P16] 本特的下一个家有三个小熊。
他们给它穿上牛仔衣，
打上花花结，把它装进车里，
本特坐在车里，像个小丑在演戏。
本特追了。
它想找一个小狗爱，
能带着它在森林里跑，
只要能扔出一个球，本特就会高兴地跑回来。

[P17] 本特追跑了，
它想找到一个小男孩，
能整天陪它一起玩。

有小姐把本特带回家，
给了它一袋骨头啃，
就是没有时间陪它玩。
本特每天都被栓在院子里。

[P18] 本特的第一任主人是包先生，
为了显示主人身份，
对本特又是打又是踢。

本特逃跑了。
它想找一个小男孩，
去抚摸它又黑又软的耳朵，
也会把它抱在怀里，让它不再恐惧。

[P3] Once there was a little boy named Rudy,
who wanted a puppy.
He kept asking;
kept begging;
kept praying.

Dedicated to Betty Jenkins Aldrich, you are my lifelong friend!
—Dorothy P. Sibert

Dedicated to Robert and Jennie, thank you for letting me read this story.
—Yang Zhicheng

[P4] Mom said:
"Rudy wants a pet,
I want to give him a kitten.
The kitten is smart and clever, lively and nimble,
I'll give him a kitten."

Rudy cried out:
"A kitten is no good at all,
You want to play with it, but it runs away,
I only want a puppy!"

[P5] Dad came over to help and said:
"When I was little, I kept a turtle.
A tiny turtle crawling slowly.
I'll give Rudy a turtle."

Rudy cried out:
"Turtles can't run at all.
They're either completely still or moving slowly.
I only want a little dog!"

[P6] Aunt Ma is moving to Rome.
"My canary needs a new home.
I'll give it to my dear Rudy.
He's the most suitable person to have it.
I'll give the canary to him."

Rudy cried out:
"Canaries can't fetch things,
they just stand on trees, swaying,
chirping all day long.
I only want a dog!"

[P7] The plump Gail said:
"Goldfish are great,
shiny and sparkling all over,
I'll give you a few, Rudy."

Rudy cried out:
"Goldfish can't sleep in bed,
they're wet, cold, and slippery.
I only want a little dog!"

[P8] Uncle Ha had some great news,
and couldn't wait to call Rudy:
"Hey, my beloved rabbit has given birth to many baby rabbits.
Rudy, come quickly and take two home to play!"

Rudy cried out:
"Rabbits can't catch mice,
they keep having babies, their noses keep twitching,
and they're lazy all afternoon.
I only want a little dog!"

[P9] Sad Rudy ran out of his house and arrived at a path.
He ran past the village,
through the street corner, turned left onto the main road,
and ran into an animal shelter,
where many animals were walking and running.

Rudy panted and said:
"I only want a little dog!
Please give me a little dog. I will train it and feed it.
We will hike in the forest, rain or shine,
just give me a little dog as a pet."

[P10] They took Rudy to a room where many puppies were in boxes.
Some were small, some were big, some looked like little foxes.
Each puppy fascinated Rudy.
Rudy carefully looked at these puppies.
Suddenly, he saw one puppy and happily called out:
"I found it! I found it!"

[P11] I only want this little dog!
I only want this little boy!

[P12] He came out of the wooden box, unhurried, wearing blue jeans.
Jet sniffed and smelled.
Jet's tail was like a flag, only like a tall drop of water.
It happily called out: 'Me, I found it!'

[P13] Rudy happily lay down in a big box to sleep.
Inside, soft paper was spread out, and Rudy felt so comfortable.
At this moment, all the dogs began barking together.
"Look here, Rudy!" a man said,
"Seeing you wander around is so hard,
so small and black, legs numb,
Come to our home,
no need to go to the stray dog shelter."

[P14] The puppy was very unhappy.
Running out of breath.
Fuming with his own anger,
Like a piece falling into tree roots.
Rushing to the cross street.

Miss Li lives in the city,
Keeping twenty-two big cats and one little cat.
She saw Jason running fast and immediately shouted:
"Come quickly to give my cats a health check-up!"

[P15] Rudy the station master was a lonely man.
He sat at the ticket counter,
and only responded to the train's whistle and its greeting to him.
At night, Bent jumped onto the tracks,
the station master blew his whistle hard, trying to call Bent back,
but ——
Bent ran off.
It could find a little boy,
who could give it a bed, so Bent could lie down and rest.

[P16] Bent's next home had three little bears.
They dressed him in a cowboy outfit,
put a fancy bow on him, and put him in the car.
Bent sat in the car, like a little clown performing.
Bent chased after it.
It wanted to find a little dog to love,
who could take it running through the forest,
and as long as it could throw a ball, Bent would happily run back.

[P17] Bent ran off,
It wanted to find a little boy,
Who could play with it all day.

A lady took Bent home,
Gave it a bag of bones to chew,
But had no time to play with it.
Bent was tied up in the yard every day.

[P18] Bent's first owner was Mr. Bao.
To show his status as owner,
he beat and kicked Bent.

Bent ran away.
It wanted to find a little boy,
to stroke its black, soft ears,
and also to hold it in his arms, so it wouldn't be afraid anymore.

[P20] I just want
a little boy

(Eng) P. Herman Pei

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《我只想要一只小狗》，展示了橙色剪影人物仰望的姿态，背景为黑色，配有作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《我只想 要一只 小狗》，画面中一个橙色剪影人物跪坐仰望，右侧有灰色剪影家庭牵着三只狗，下方标注了作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息。
[P3] 本页为绘本的扉页，左侧有作者和译者的献词，右侧以文字叙述了主角鲁迪渴望拥有一只小狗的心情，并配有一幅鲁迪趴卧仰望的插图。
[P4] 妈妈想给鲁迪一只聪明活泼的小猫作为宠物，但鲁迪哭喊着拒绝，坚持只想要一只小狗。
[P5] 爸爸提议给鲁迪一只乌龟作为宠物，但鲁迪拒绝并哭喊着强调自己只想要一只小狗。
[P6] 马大姑想把她的金丝雀送给鲁迪，但鲁迪拒绝了，坚持只想要一只小狗。
[P7] 该利想送给鲁迪几条金鱼作为宠物，但鲁迪拒绝了，坚持只想要一只小狗，并解释了金鱼不适合在床睡的原因。
[P8] 哈大叔打电话告诉鲁迪他心爱的兔子生了好多小兔子，邀请鲁迪带两只回去玩，但鲁迪哭喊着拒绝，坚持只想要一只小狗。
[P9] 伤心的鲁迪跑出家门，来到一条小路，经过村庄和大街拐角后，跑进一个动物收容所。他喘着气向收容所表达自己只想要一只小狗，并描述了与小狗一起徒步、风雨无阻的愿景。
[P10] 鲁迪来到动物收容所，看到许多小狗后非常着迷，最终发现了一只特别的小狗并兴奋地喊出找到了。
[P11] 鲁迪在动物收容所里抱着一只黑色小狗，兴奋地表达自己只想要这只小狗，同时小狗也似乎在回应他，表达了对他的喜爱。
[P12] 鲁迪在动物收容所里发现了一只黑色小狗，小狗从木箱中走出，嗅闻四周，尾巴摇摆，兴奋地叫喊着找到了，表现出对鲁迪的亲近和喜悦。
[P13] 鲁迪在收容所的纸箱里安顿下来，感到舒适，但其他狗的叫声引起注意，一位工作人员看到他后，表示愿意收养他，带他回家，不必再流浪。
[P14] 鲁迪抱着小狗在街上奔跑，小狗显得不高兴且气喘吁吁。画面右侧描绘了李小姐在城里养着许多猫，她看到有人跑过，便大声喊着要给猫咪做保健。
[P15] 本特在火车站跳上铁轨，站长吹哨试图唤回它，但本特跑开了。画面描绘了本特渴望找到一个能给它床铺和休息的小男孩。
[P16] 本特被三个小熊收养，他们为它打扮并带它乘车玩耍，但本特仍怀念能一起奔跑的狗伙伴，渴望有人扔球让它追逐。
[P17] 本特在奔跑后渴望找到一个能陪它玩耍的小男孩，但被一位小姐带回家后，虽然得到食物，却因无人陪伴而被拴在院子里，感到孤单。
[P18] 本特的第一任主人对它又打又踢，它因此逃跑，并渴望找到一个能抚摸它、抱它、让它不再恐惧的小男孩。
[P20] 本页为绘本的封面或扉页，展示了书名《找只想小男孩》及作者、译者和出版社信息，画面中有一只黑色小狗的剪影和一群人的影子，暗示小狗在寻找一个愿意陪伴它的孩子。
[P21] 本页为绘本封面或扉页，展示书名《找一个只想小男孩》，画面为黑色背景上的黄色文字和剪影，暗示小狗在寻找一个愿意陪伴它的孩子。
